collection.credit:
CREDITS: Lorsieab2 proposed making the full competition suite available in
VV1, VV2, VV3, VV4 and VV5, rewriting each to reflect its setting, and
specifically proposed VV5 Heathen/Isolan competitors and judges with political
tensions. The original VV2 Cooking Contest's premise, mechanics and text are
by Lorsieab2. The game-specific adaptations, fresh dialogue, branching,
political plots and integration notes below are written by ChatGPT.
Existing universal competitions and their previous credits remain intact.

ledger.text: Optional: use existing VV5 woodworking showcase
ledger.why: designer note: the optional woodworking-showcase base

contest.text: The two teams build rival spans over a shallow crossing. One favors old Isolan stonework; the other uses a novel woven support. The master builder calls the latter "a nest pretending to be a bridge." A fair load test may vindicate either. If the two teams collaborate, the final structure can symbolically join the communities without automatically ending their political disagreements.
contest.name: The Bridge Between Neighbors
